description: Fix scheme descriptions showing in English only, complete missing Marathi translation keys, update Navbar to use t() for nav labels, add roadmap card to dashboard, and delete the dead /connect page. These are all independent UI/translation fixes that do not depend on FEAT-001 backend changes, but FEAT-001's language restriction (hi/mr/en only) should be done first so mr.ts keys added here align with the trimmed LanguageCode type.
steps: 1. Read backend/src/routes/schemes.js fully to see how scheme name/description are returned. Identify if JSONB {en,hi,mr} objects are returned raw or pre-selected.

2. In backend/src/routes/schemes.js recommendations endpoint: extract Accept-Language header or add ?lang= query param support. In the SQL query or post-processing, select name[lang] and description[lang] (or use Postgres jsonb -> operator: name->>'hi') when returning scheme data to the frontend. Fall back to name->>'en' if the lang key is missing.

3. In frontend/i18n/mr.ts: add all missing keys. Translate them to Marathi. 4. In frontend/components/ui/Navbar.tsx: replace hardcoded 'Home', 'Schemes', 'Analyse', 'Connect' with t('nav.home'), t('nav.mySchemes'), t('nav.documents'), t('nav.connect') respectively.

5. In frontend/app/dashboard/page.tsx: add a roadmap action card to the actionCards array: { icon: '🗺️', title: t('nav.roadmap') || 'Financial Roadmap', desc: 'See your personalized financial action plan', href: '/roadmap', bgColor: 'bg-purple-50', borderColor: 'border-purple-200' }.
6. Delete frontend/app/connect/page.tsx — the route is dead (Navbar and MobileNav both link to /channels, not /connect).
7. Run: cd frontend && npm run build — confirm 0 errors.
acceptance_criteria: Scheme names and descriptions render in Hindi when UI language is Hindi, Marathi when Marathi.
Switching UI to Marathi — all navbar labels, dashboard cards, auth page, and results page display in Marathi.
Navbar labels change to Hindi/Marathi when language is switched.
Dashboard shows 7 action cards including one for 'Financial Roadmap' / 'वित्तीय रोडमैप'.
npm run build completes with 0 errors.
